THE PORTRAIT EDIT
ISSUE 02 / THE PROMPT ISSUE
KNITWEAR & LAYERS
095
STUDY 038
Butter Yellow Tee & Plaid Mini
Rights check
Source: 24377.jpg
IMAGE PROMPT
An original young woman with long, straight copper-red
hair and freckles stands against a soft gray wall. She
wears a butter-yellow long-sleeve fitted top with a
scoop neck and a small script graphic, plus a thin silver
pendant necklace. Below, a brown houndstooth pleated
mini skirt with a brown leather belt, and tall taupe
knee-high socks. Her expression is calm and direct.
Soft, even daylight, a palette of butter yellow, warm
brown, and camel. Playful and preppy, in the style of a
Y2K-inspired fashion catalog.
Playful, preppy, bright
WORKING NOTES
- The yellow top and houndstooth skirt create the color
contrast.
- Use 'full-length' to show the socks and skirt together.
Try this: Use full-length framing to show the socks and
skirt.
